You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0230.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
import json
names=['A','B','C','D','E','F','G','H','Q','P','N','M','L','K','J','O_furan','R','S','T','U','V','W','X','O_pyran','Me_A','Me_C','Me_E','Me_G','Me_K','Me_S','Me_U','OH_H','OH_T','OH_M','O_L']
positions=[(212,105),(316,45),(420,105),(523,45),(627,105),(627,225),(771,305),(771,455),(653,467),(628,586),(524,644),(524,765),(627,825),(731,765),(731,644),(821,555),(420,585),(316,645),(212,585),(212,465),(316,405),(316,285),(212,225),(420,466),(111,47),(420,223),(731,45),(889,244),(841,825),(316,766),(108,405),(912,425),(109,644),(419,825),(627,945)]
ox=[15,23,31,32,33,34]
rw=Chem.RWMol()
for i in range(len(names)):
    a=Chem.Atom('O' if i in ox else 'C')
    a.SetProp('atomNote',str(i))
    rw.AddAtom(a)
bonds=[(0,1,1),(1,2,2),(2,3,1),(3,4,1),(4,5,1),(5,6,1),(6,7,1),(7,8,1),(8,9,2),(9,10,1),(10,11,2),(11,12,1),(12,13,1),(13,14,2),(14,9,1),(7,15,1),(15,14,1),(10,16,1),(16,17,1),(17,18,1),(18,19,1),(19,20,1),(20,21,1),(21,22,1),(22,0,1),(20,23,1),(23,16,1),(0,24,1),(2,25,1),(4,26,1),(6,27,1),(13,28,1),(17,29,1),(19,30,1),(7,31,1),(18,32,1),(11,33,1),(12,34,2)]
for a,b,o in bonds:rw.AddBond(a,b,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if o==2 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms());conf.Set3D(False)
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(positions): conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x/100.,-y/100.,0))
m.AddConformer(conf)
for a,b,d in [(0,24,'d'),(4,26,'w'),(6,27,'d'),(7,31,'w'),(20,23,'w'),(19,30,'w'),(18,32,'w'),(17,29,'d')]:
    m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(a,b).SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH if d=='d' else Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m)
b=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(1,2);b.SetStereoAtoms(0,3);b.SetStereo(Chem.BondStereo.STEREOE)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('Formula:',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
print('SMILES:',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
print('Chiral centers:',[(i,names[i],cip) for i,cip in Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m,includeUnassigned=True)])
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'target.mol')
from rdkit.Chem.Draw import rdMolDraw2D
pic=rdMolDraw2D.MolDraw2DCairo(1000,1000)
pic.DrawMolecule(m);pic.FinishDrawing();open('parsed.png','wb').write(pic.GetDrawingText())
m.RemoveAllConformers()
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=230;p.numThreads=8;p.useMacrocycleTorsions=True;p.useMacrocycle14config=True;p.pruneRmsThresh=0.3;p.maxIterations=3000
cids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=160,params=p)
print('Embedded:',len(cids),flush=True)
res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m,numThreads=8,maxIters=1800)
ranking=sorted((energy,i,status) for i,(status,energy) in enumerate(res))
print('Best:',ranking[:12],flush=True)
open('rank.json','w').write(json.dumps(ranking))
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'ensemble_best.mol',confId=ranking[0][1])
for k,(_,cid,_) in enumerate(ranking[:5]):
    Chem.MolToXYZFile(m,f'conf_{k}.xyz',confId=cid)
Chem.MolToXYZFile(m,'answer.xyz',confId=ranking[0][1])
PY

python - <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolTransforms
import numpy as np,re
m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('ensemble_best.mol',removeHs=False)
print('Reference',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m,includeUnassigned=True))
for i in [0,2,3]:
 p=f'opt_{i}/xtbopt.xyz';x=Chem.MolFromXYZFile(p);t=Chem.Mol(m);t.RemoveAllConformers();t.AddConformer(x.GetConformer())
 Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(t,replaceExistingTags=True)
 print(i,Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(t,includeUnassigned=True), 'alkene dihedral',rdMolTransforms.GetDihedralDeg(t.GetConformer(),0,1,2,3))
 ds=[(b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx(),rdMolTransforms.GetBondLength(t.GetConformer(),b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx())) for b in t.GetBonds()]
 print('largest heavy bond length',max(d for a,b,d in ds if a<35 and b<35))
 log=open(f'opt_{i}/xtb.log').read(); print(re.findall(r'TOTAL ENERGY\s+([-\d.]+)',log)[-1])
PY
